title: Maple Finance sets 2027 $15B AUM goal, faces data discrepancies and leadership risks
digest:
Maple Finance announced a 2027 AUM target of $15 billion through TradFi partnerships and tokenized equity lending, with CEO Sidney Powell citing ongoing bank negotiations for Bitcoin-backed warehouse facilities.

Current AUM figures conflict: November 18 Crypto Briefing reported $47-48B (up 18% YoY), while earlier Cointelegraph cited $3.9B with 18% YoY growth. Both sources claim Q3 revenue growth slowed to 5% from 25% QoQ.

Strategic risks include unconfirmed bank deals (as of Nov 2026), leadership instability (CEO Sid Powell and CFO Joe Flanagan departed in Nov 2026), and execution challenges merging DeFi/TradFi systems. New partnerships with Robinhood Chain are highlighted as liquidity expansion efforts.
